note: Set A covers seven claims, all faithfully supported, and binds attributes to the correct components (solar thermal collector, control system), including the hot water production function and the passive design strategy of the thermal envelope. Set B's five claims are essentially accurate but omit the passive design and hot water production facts and bind collector and control-system attributes to HARVEST HOME as a whole rather than to the specific components, making them less precise. Neither set invents values or drops stated conditions such as 'when required'. Overall A is more complete and better bound with no errors of its own.
